integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic surreal body horror, photorealistic. <Subject 1> stands alone in a tiled changing room at a public swimming pool, framed from the knees up, slightly tense but otherwise normal. The camera pushes in at slow speed. A clean, deliberate seam appears down the length of the spine, as though the body were a garment built around something inside it. The seam slowly opens and, without blood or injury, the outer body separates like a fitted soft suit, skin and clothing pulling apart together as one hollow shell. From within, <Subject 2> steps forward in one controlled movement, lifting one leg free and then the other. The empty shell stays upright for a moment like a shed skin, then folds softly to the floor. In the final moment <Subject 2> turns toward the camera with a composed, unreadable expression.

overall_soundscape: Quiet room ambience, a soft fabric-like separation, slow deliberate footsteps, and the gentle collapse of the empty shell.
